gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-biryani: Tilt Neon draws bold, tube-like letters of constant width, with a big x-height and short ascenders that feel loud and sure. Biryani then steps in, approachable and clear, with generous eyes on every e.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-chocolate-classical-: Tilt Neon is bold and commanding, its tube-like strokes holding one width with no calligraphic thinning anywhere in the letters. Chocolate Classical Sans adds a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-fresca: Tube-like strokes of constant width give Tilt Neon its bold, commanding presence, with short ascenders over a large x-height. Fresca stays modern and clean, its open apertures keeping counters connected to outside space.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-funnel-sans: Loud, tubular, unmistakable: Tilt Neon has a splayed c terminal and a large x-height under short ascenders. Funnel Sans keeps quiet and professional below, leaving Tilt Neon to earn its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-georama: Chunky, constant-stroke letters: Tilt Neon never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes inside a word. Georama is approachable underneath, with a c opened like a bracelet pulled apart that carries the eye along for pages.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hind-guntur: Loud and tube-shaped, Tilt Neon commands attention at a glance. Hind Guntur brings tall, stamped-metal lowercase forms and wide gaps at the curve ends, so text keeps moving smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hind-mysuru: Commanding from the first glance, Tilt Neon holds a constant tube-like stroke under short ascenders and a large x-height. Hind Mysuru lets text flow contemporary and smooth, its lowercase a left ajar and tops pressed near ascender height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. Hind Siliguri sits under Tilt Neon's tube-like heading and keeps a full page of text feeling approachable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-kedebideri: A stripe of constant ink, loud and tube-like: that is Tilt Neon. Kedebideri brings a skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters, and that firm-versus-friendly split is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-martel-sans: Tube-like strokes that never swell or thin mark Tilt Neon, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Martel Sans has generous curve openings and a high mean line, so a modest body size is enough.
